narrative:
Stark County has 247,411 registered voters, with 17.0% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 23.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 49.8%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 26.0 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.4% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean -0.9% D−R vs -5.4% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
